sources_considered.why: Read the contemporaneous company account of operating service and claimed improvements in difficult situations.
Read the incident report, including Cruise's account. It establishes a relevant event but not its technical cause.
Read successfully, but it describes 2022 deployments and does not establish capability in the target period.

evidence_items.explanation: This documents a difficult emergency-vehicle encounter involving Cruise. The article also reports Cruise's account that its vehicle entered on green and was struck; the collision alone neither assigns fault nor establishes the capability of every system.

Waymo reported established driverless service and improving construction-zone and emergency-scene handling. This is material evidence against interpreting the claim as an inability to handle any unusual situation, but it does not demonstrate a general solution.

unresolved_gaps: No comprehensive assessment of all available systems against unforeseen situations was found.
Marcus supplies no reliability threshold for deciding when a system can deal with the problem.
The available incident and service reports do not bridge the gap between individual successes or failures and the universal proposition.
